title: Application for a tax break for St. Albans affordable housing, Queens
summary: This measure would exempt a housing property at Block 12334, Lot 273 in Queens from real property taxes under state law covering affordable housing developments. The exemption benefits Albans Housing Development Fund Corporation and its owner WFHA St. Albans LLC and would last until a regulatory agreement with the city housing agency is signed. The exemption could end early if the property is not run under the required rules or ownership changes without city approval.
